List the stimuli in the database

Source: R/catalog.R
list_items.Rd

List the stimuli in the database

Usage

list_items(version = "latest")

Arguments

version

Release version, or "latest".

Value

A tibble with one row per item.

Examples

# \donttest{
list_items()
#> # A tibble: 2,217 × 4
#>    item_id                              name        standardized_name n_datasets
